name: Kyle Powys Whyte
shortBio: Citizen Potawatomi environmental philosopher who theorized anthropogenic climate change as intensified colonialism and formulated "collective continuance" and relational tipping points.
centralQuestion: Why must climate justice confront settler colonialism and restore Indigenous "collective continuance" rather than reproducing urgent eco-colonialism?

keyWorks.title: Indigenous Climate Change Studies: Indigenizing Futures, Decolonizing the Anthropocene
keyWorks.description: Frames environmental crisis through Indigenous seasonal kinship, collective continuance, and colonial déjà vu.

keyWorks.title: Too Late for Indigenous Climate Justice: Ecological and Relational Tipping Points
keyWorks.description: Argues that climate urgency without consent, trust, and reciprocity risks replicating colonial harms.
